recognize_zh: 骨髓顆粒周邊聚集大量細胞核偏心、細胞質藍色並有核旁淡染區的漿細胞，部分較大、染色質較開放，與少數嗜中性球及淋巴球混雜，符合漿細胞骨髓瘤復發時漿細胞明顯增加。
features: Marrow particle with numerous plasma cells showing eccentric nuclei and moderate to abundant blue cytoplasm
Perinuclear hof visible in many plasma cells
Variation in size with some larger plasma cells having more open chromatin (immature forms)
Occasional binucleated plasma cell and a cell with a visible nucleolus
Admixed neutrophils, lymphocytes and erythroid precursors with fat spaces
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle with fat spaces and a markedly increased population of plasma cells occurring singly and in clusters. The plasma cells have eccentric nuclei, perinuclear hofs, and basophilic cytoplasm, with variation in size, some immature forms with open chromatin, and occasional binucleated cells. Residual neutrophils, lymphocytes, and erythroid precursors are present. Findings are consistent with involvement by plasma cell myeloma, supporting relapse in the clinical context; plasma cell percentage should be quantified and clonality confirmed by flow cytometry or light-chain immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature, rarely exceed 10% of cells, cluster around vessels, and are polytypic for kappa and lambda.
Shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with CD20-positive B cells and MYD88 L265P.
Consists of sheets of large plasmablasts with prominent nucleoli and high Ki-67, often EBER positive, in immunocompromised patients.
Erythroid precursors have central round nuclei and no hof, and are CD71/E-cadherin positive but CD138-negative.
